Name: Advanced_Copper_Tools
Author: Jared
Description: Adds copper-and-bronze metalworking content: metal sheets and nails, a small copper stove, wearable metal pan (multi-metal), large copper saw with bonus tree-cutting, wheelbarrow with weight reduction, copper bathtub (3 states, with a Hot Bath tier for keeping the fire stoked), 4-variant metal lantern with rendered oil, copper oil flask, copper tea kettle, copper cauldron for batch cooking and brewing, sealed copper chest, a 3-variant Tea Blending Station with six herb slots, passive drying, a Grind All action, a built-in heated water reservoir, and three brewable herbal teas (Calming, Warming, Focus). Includes copper armor: helmet, bracers, greaves, and torso armor — all furnace-recyclable — plus a tougher iron-grade armor tier forged from iron sheets. The oil flask and cauldron now track the metal they were built from (copper through white bronze). Also adds a copper watering can and a copper-rim chamberpot. Adds a branching cave system east of Waterfall Caves: Copper Vein Cave (north), Tin Vein Cave (east), and Iron Vein Cave (south) — each with a minable ore vein.
